name: Miami-Dade
crosswalk_note: Name and FIPS changed in 1997. Direct one-to-one successor for this build.

name: Gallatin
crosswalk_note: Montana's Yellowstone National Park county-equivalent was dissolved in 1997. Mapped to Gallatin County for continuity with the Phase 1 crosswalk; a small population share belonged with Park County.

name: Carson City
crosswalk_note: Ormsby County and Carson City consolidated in 1969. Direct successor.

name: Dewey
crosswalk_note: Armstrong County was abolished and absorbed into Dewey County in 1952. Direct successor for this build.

name: Jackson
crosswalk_note: Washabaugh County was absorbed into Jackson County in 1983. Direct successor for this build.

name: Chesapeake
crosswalk_note: The source row aggregates Norfolk County, Norfolk city, South Norfolk city, and Portsmouth city. Mapped to Chesapeake city, the principal Norfolk County/South Norfolk successor; Norfolk and Portsmouth city totals cannot be separated.

name: Hampton
crosswalk_note: Elizabeth City County and Hampton consolidated in 1952. Mapped to Hampton city.

name: Newport News
crosswalk_note: Warwick County and Newport News consolidated in 1958. Direct successor.

name: Suffolk
crosswalk_note: Nansemond County and Suffolk consolidated in 1974. Mapped to Suffolk city.

name: Virginia Beach
crosswalk_note: Princess Anne County and Virginia Beach consolidated in 1963. Direct successor.

name: Park
crosswalk_note: Wyoming's Yellowstone National Park county-equivalent was dissolved before the modern county layout. Mapped to Park County for this build; the source row has population but no reported congregations or members.
